_comment: The words on the game's screens and in its messages that every screen shares; each screen's own are in its
ui_<screen>.json. A label is said one way (the first line of its pool). {name} is a value the game fills in.
language.name: this language's name in the Settings picker; a translation (text/<language>/) gives its own.
format.percent: a share in whole percent, {percent} the number (0 to 100; {percent:0} writes it without decimals).

lines.language.name: English
lines.settings.language.restart: The game will speak {language} the next time it starts.
lines.settings.traffic.tip: How busy the roads are in a drive in traffic, against each road's own.
lines.settings.traffic_detail.tip: How much of the traffic your machine carries: how many different cars, how sharp their textures, how many on the road. Low suits a graphics card with little memory.
lines.settings.traffic_models.tip: The traffic is made from the cars you have installed, the first time a road needs them, and kept in the game's own folder. Nothing goes into Assetto Corsa's folders.
lines.settings.traffic_models.none: No traffic cars made yet: they are made the first time a road needs them.
lines.settings.traffic_models.summary: {count} traffic cars made from your cars, {mb} MB
lines.settings.traffic_models.delete.confirm: Delete every traffic car made from your cars? They are made again, from your cars, the next time a road needs them.
lines.settings.restart.title: Restart Needed
lines.settings.not_saved: The settings could not be saved. The details are in the log.
